lines.text: ذلك البَلَد في الطُّول الى ناحية مكّة التي هي فيها في العرض فحيْث بلَغ فتَعلَّمْ عليه عَلامة في مُحيط
lines.plain: ذلك البَلَد في الطُّول الى ناحية مكّة التي هي فيها في العرض فحيْث بلَغ فتَعلَّمْ عليه عَلامة في مُحيط

lines.text: الدائرة وأَخْرِجْ خَطًّا مستقيمًا من مَرْكَز الدائرة الى تلك العَلامة فذلك الخطّ هو سَمْت مَكّة من
lines.plain: الدائرة وأَخْرِجْ خَطًّا مستقيمًا من مَرْكَز الدائرة الى تلك العَلامة فذلك الخطّ هو سَمْت مَكّة من

lines.text: وعلى نحو قِسْمة هذَيْن الرُّبْعَيْن تقسِم الرُّبْعَيْن الباقِيَيْن{n:2} ان شاء اللّٰه
lines.plain: وعلى نحو قِسْمة هذَيْن الرُّبْعَيْن تقسِم الرُّبْعَيْن الباقِيَيْن ان شاء اللّٰه

lines.text: قال تتَّخِذ رُخامة واسعة مُرَبَّعة مُسْتَطِيلة وترسُم على اطرافها {ov:ا} {ov:ب} {ov:ج} {ov:د} وتتَّخِذ في ثُلْثَيْ{mR:20}{mL:f. 140,v.}
lines.plain: قال تتَّخِذ رُخامة واسعة مُرَبَّعة مُسْتَطِيلة وترسُم على اطرافها ا ب ج د وتتَّخِذ في ثُلْثَيْ

lines.text: عَرْضها ووَسَط طُولها مَرْكَزًا عليه عَلامة {ov:ه} وتُدير عليه دائرة وتُربِّعها بخَطَّيْن يتقاطَعَانِ على زَوَايا قائمة
lines.plain: عَرْضها ووَسَط طُولها مَرْكَزًا عليه عَلامة ه وتُدير عليه دائرة وتُربِّعها بخَطَّيْن يتقاطَعَانِ على زَوَايا قائمة

lines.text: وتُنْفِذهما الى اطراف الرُّخامة وتجعَل الخطّ الواحد الأطْوَل الذي يمتَدّ في طول الرخامة خطّ ما بين
lines.plain: وتُنْفِذهما الى اطراف الرُّخامة وتجعَل الخطّ الواحد الأطْوَل الذي يمتَدّ في طول الرخامة خطّ ما بين

notes.text: 1) Cod. addit وصورة الرخامه هو (sic) مصور (sic) في الوجه الاخر — 2) Cod. الباقيه

observations: L02, L05: long joins (هـو and, at the end of the line, مـن on L02; واسعـة and وتتَّخِـذ on L05).

The page ends the account of the azimuth of Mecca, gives the figure of the sundial and begins the second description of the slab: three lines of text at its head (L01 to L03), the figure, one line under the figure set in the middle of the measure (L04), three lines of text (L05 to L07), a rule and one line of notes; it has no signature. L01 and L02 run the full measure (L01 from 116.5 to 540.2 pt); L03 is short («ذلك البَلَد.» with the note figure, from 486.2 to 539.8 pt; two specks of the scan at 392 and 428 pt on its height are no print). L04 stands from 185.6 to 466.8 pt. L05 begins a paragraph with «قال» and is set in at its head (from 115.0 to 514.6 pt); L06 and L07 run the full measure (114.7 to 539.1 and 538.8 pt). The baselines stand at 124.6, 150.8 and 177.8 pt down, L04 at 585.7 pt, L05 to L07 at 631.4, 657.7 and 683.6 pt. Nallino's line number 20 stands in the right margin beside L05 (546.1 to 556.2 pt). The folio number «f. 140,r.» stands in the left margin at the height of the head of the figure (58.0 to 85.7 pt across, its baseline 207 pt down), beside the letter ب of the figure, where no line of text stands; the folio number «f. 140,v.» stands in the left margin beside L05 (76.7 to 107.3 pt). No asterisk stands in the text for either of them: the figure fills the one side of the leaf and the text goes on with the paragraph of L05 on the other. A full stop stands after البَلَد on L03, before the note figure; the page has no other points.

The page has no brackets and no numerals in the text. Bars stand over the four letters ا, ب, ج and د on L05, each letter under its own bar (from 244.1 to 257.4, 228.2 to 241.0, 211.3 to 224.2 and 195.5 to 207.8 pt), and over the letter ه on L06 (from 353.6 to 367.0 pt); the ه is a small ring (2.6 x 3.2 pt).

The note figures: 1 after the full stop of L03 (2.9 x 6.8 pt) and 2 after الباقِيَيْن on L04 (4.3 x 6.5 pt). The rule stands from 114.1 to 215.6 pt (101.5 pt long) at 712 pt down. The notes are one line (baseline 740.9 pt, from 141.8 to 449.3 pt), with a dash between note 1 and note 2. In note 1 the words of the codex after «Cod. addit» run from right to left as one passage, وصورة الرخامه هو مصور في الوجه الاخر, with «(sic)» set in it after هو and after مصور: its first word وصورة stands at the right, beside the dash, and its last words في الوجه الاخر at the left, after «addit». The Arabic of the notes has no signs; الرخامه and الباقيه end in a hā' without dots, وصورة has the two dots.

The figure (F01) stands between L03 and L04; it is drawn by hand in the print, and its letters and words are written by hand, not set in type. An oblong frame (from 96.7 to 560.0 pt across, from 220.2 to 539.0 pt down; its right side and its foot heavier) has the letters ا, ب, ج, د outside its corners (upper right, upper left, lower right, lower left), «الجنوب» over it and «الشمال» under it. The line of east and west crosses it, with «المشرق» at the left and «المغرب» at the right, and the line of midday goes down it, with «خطّ نصف النهار» written downward beside its foot; they meet at the centre ه (327.5 pt across, 331.4 pt down). About the centre stand three circles (radii 101.0, 98.0 and 91.2 pt); between the two outer ones a scale of ninety bars to the quarter stands in the upper left and the lower right quarter, with a line at every tenth degree and a tick at every fifth between the middle and the inner circle, and in the upper left quarter the tens in letters, ي, ك, ل, م, ن, س, ع, ف, ص, each with its head toward the ring. Two dashed curves cross the frame, the upper one named «السرطان» near both ends and the lower one «الجدي»; ten hour lines and the line of midday run between them, each with م at its head and ل at its foot, and between them the names of the twelve hours are written downward, from «الاولى» at the right to «الثانية عشرة» at the left, with «الساعة» over the first and over the last two. A dashed line goes down beside the line of midday, with ع at its head and at its foot and ض at the head and the foot of the line of midday; a dashed line goes level across the ring, with ك outside the ring at both ends; a line goes from the centre to the ring, with لا beside it, and a short line from the centre ends in a round dot, with س beside it. The figure is redrawn from measurements of the master scan (three circles, 241 straight lines, the two dashed curves as traced lines, one dot); its 67 letters and words stand in type at the places, the turnings and the lengths of the written ones. Of the written words «الخامسة» shows its dots only faintly; a small stroke beside «المشرق» and a dot beside «الجنوب» are marks of the scan, not letters.

L01: البَلَد: a fatha over the bā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 2.2 pt); so too on L03 (3.6 x 2.2 and 2.5 x 1.8 pt). الطُّول: over the ṭā' a shadda with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 6.8 pt); طُولها on L06 has a damma over the ṭā' (2.5 x 5.0 pt); طول on L07 has no sign. مكّة: a shadda over the long kāf, which stands on the upper stroke of the letter and touches it; the mīm has no sign; مَكّة on L02 has a fatha over the mīm (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and the shadda, which touches the kāf in the same way. فحيْث: a round sukun over the yā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). بلَغ: a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 2.5 pt). فتَعلَّمْ: a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (4.0 x 2.2 pt), over the lām a shadda with a fatha above it in one cluster (4.0 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the mīm (2.9 x 2.9 pt). عَلامة: a fatha over the ʿayn (4.0 x 2.5 pt); so too العَلامة on L02 (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and عَلامة on L06 (4.0 x 2.5 pt). مُحيط: a damma over the mīm (2.9 x 5.0 pt). ذلك, في, الى, ناحية, التي, هي, فيها, العرض and عليه have no signs; so too ذلك on L03, في on L05 and L07, الى on L02 and L07 and عليه twice on L06.

L02: الدائرة: the hamza over the tooth (3.2 x 3.6 pt); so too later on the line (2.9 x 3.2 pt) and دائرة on L06 (2.5 x 3.2 pt). وأَخْرِجْ: over the alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 5.4 pt), a round sukun over the khā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt), a kasra under the rā', which touches the tail of the letter, and a round sukun over the jīm (2.5 x 2.9 pt). خَطًّا: a fatha over the khā' (4.0 x 2.9 pt); the shadda with the fathatan above it stands on the top of the ṭā' and touches it. مستقيمًا: the fathatan touches the top of the alif; the two dots of the tā' and of the qāf touch their letters. من: no sign, twice; the dot of the nūn stands in the bowl of the letter. مَرْكَز: a fatha over the mīm (4.0 x 2.5 pt), a round sukun over the rā' (2.9 x 3.2 pt) and a fatha over the kāf (4.0 x 2.5 pt); مَرْكَزًا on L06 has the same signs (4.0 x 2.5, 2.5 x 2.9 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt) and the fathatan (4.0 x 3.2 pt). الخطّ: a shadda over the ṭā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt); the shadda of الخطّ and of خطّ on L07 touches the top of the ṭā'. سَمْت: a fatha over the sīn (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and a round sukun over the mīm (2.9 x 2.9 pt). تلك, فذلك and هو have no signs.

L04: نحو: no signs; the nūn stands as a small tooth over the head of the ḥā' (4.0 x 3.6 pt), with its dot above it (2.2 x 1.8 pt), in both copies. قِسْمة: a kasra under the qāf (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.9 pt). هذَيْن: a fatha over the dot of the dhāl (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt); the two dots of the yā' touch the letter in the master scan and stand free in the second copy. الرُّبْعَيْن: over the rā' a shadda with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 6.5 pt), a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the ʿayn (3.6 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt); later on the line the damma and the shadda stand apart (2.2 x 4.3 and 3.6 x 2.5 pt), with the sukun (2.5 x 2.5 pt), the fatha (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and the sukun (2.5 x 2.9 pt); the yā' has its two dots in both. تقسِم: a kasra under the sīn (3.6 x 2.2 pt). الباقِيَيْن: a kasra under the qāf (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the first yā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the second (2.2 x 2.5 pt); both have their two dots; the dot of the nūn stands in the bowl of the letter. ان: no hamza. شاء: the hamza on the line. اللّٰه: a shadda (3.6 x 2.2 pt) with the upright alif over it (1.8 x 3.6 pt). وعلى has no sign; so too على on L05 and L06.

L05: تتَّخِذ: over the second tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.5 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the khā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt); وتتَّخِذ later on the line has the shadda and the fatha in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt) and the kasra (2.9 x 2.2 pt). رُخامة: a damma over the rā' (2.9 x 5.0 pt); الرُّخامة on L07 has over the rā' a shadda with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 6.8 pt); الرخامة later on L07 has no sign. مُرَبَّعة: a damma over the mīm (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a fatha over the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and over the bā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt). مُسْتَطِيلة: a damma over the mīm (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the ṭā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt). وترسُم: a damma over the sīn (2.9 x 5.0 pt). اطرافها: no hamza; so too اطراف on L07. ثُلْثَيْ: a damma over the first thā' (2.9 x 5.0 pt), a sukun on the top of the lām, which it touches, a fatha over the second thā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.9 x 2.9 pt); the yā' has its two dots under it. قال and واسعة have no signs.

L06: عَرْضها: a fatha over the ʿayn (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and a round sukun over the rā' (2.9 x 2.9 pt). ووَسَط: a fatha over the second wāw (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the sīn (4.0 x 2.5 pt). وتُدير: a damma over the two dots of the tā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt); the yā' is printed without its two dots, in both copies, as on pp. 203, 204 and 206. وتُربِّعها: a damma over the two dots of the tā' (2.5 x 5.0 pt), a shadda over the bā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under it, beside its dot (3.6 x 2.2 pt); the rā' has no sign. بخَطَّيْن: a fatha over the khā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a shadda with a fatha above it on the top of the ṭā', which it touches, and a round sukun over the yā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt); the yā' has its two dots. يتقاطَعَانِ: a fatha over the ṭā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the ʿayn (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the nūn (4.0 x 2.2 pt), in both copies. زَوَايا: a fatha over the dot of the zāy (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the wāw (3.6 x 2.2 pt). قائمة: the hamza over the tooth (3.2 x 3.6 pt); the two dots of the qāf touch the letter.

L07: وتُنْفِذهما: a damma over the tā' (2.9 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the nūn (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a kasra under the fā' (4.0 x 2.5 pt); the dots of the tā' and of the nūn touch their letters. وتجعَل: a fatha over the ʿayn (3.6 x 2.2 pt). الأطْوَل: the bare hamza over the alif (3.2 x 3.2 pt), a round sukun over the ṭā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a fatha over the wāw (3.6 x 2.5 pt), in both copies. يمتَدّ: a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a shadda over the dāl (3.2 x 2.5 pt). الواحد, الذي, ما and بين have no signs.

figures.name: F01
figures.note: the figure of chapter 56, the plane sundial, drawn by hand in the print: an oblong frame (its right side and its foot heavier), with the letters ا, ب, ج, د outside its corners (upper right, upper left, lower right, lower left) and the words «الجنوب» over it and «الشمال» under it; the line of east and west across it, with «المشرق» at the left and «المغرب» at the right, and the line of midday down it («خطّ نصف النهار», written downward beside its foot), meeting at the centre ه; about the centre three circles (radii 101.0, 98.0 and 91.2 pt), the two outer ones close together: between them, in the upper left quarter and in the lower right quarter, a scale of ninety bars to the quarter, one to the degree, counted from the line of midday; between the middle and the inner circle, in the same two quarters, a line at every tenth degree and a short tick at every fifth; inside the inner circle, in the upper left quarter, the tens of the scale in letters, ي, ك, ل, م, ن, س, ع, ف, ص, from the line of midday to the line of east and west, each with its head toward the ring. Two dashed curves cross the frame from side to side: the upper one, named «السرطان» near both ends, comes down to a little under the centre; the lower one, named «الجدي» near both ends, rises to its top under the centre. Ten hour lines run from the upper curve down to the lower one, five on each side of the line of midday; the two next to the line of midday, and that line itself, are broken in three pieces, the middle piece a little heavier. A letter م stands at the head of each of these eleven lines and a letter ل at its foot. Between the lines the names of the hours are written downward: from the right «الاولى» (with «الساعة» over it, above the line of east and west), «الثانية», «الثالثة», «الرابعة», «الخامسة», «السادسة», «السابعة», «الثامنة», «التاسعة», «العاشرة», «الحادية عشرة» and «الثانية عشرة» (with «الساعة» over them at the left). A dashed line runs down a little to the left of the line of midday, from the top of the frame to the upper curve and again from the lower curve to the ring, with ع at its head and at its foot, where ض stands beside the line of midday; a dashed line runs level across the ring above the centre, with ك outside the ring at both its ends; a line goes from the centre up to the ring at the left of the line of midday, with لا beside it where the two dashed lines cross it, and a short line from the centre up to the right, ending in a round dot (2.85 pt across), with س beside its end. Measured on the master scan at 1200 dpi (scratch fig/m945_*.py, fig/el945.py): the circles and the straight lines are least-squares fits to the middle of their strokes, with their stroke widths; the lines of the frame are drawn to their meetings, the hour lines to their meetings with the traced curves, the lines from the centre from the meeting of the two axes; the dashed straight lines carry the middle lengths of their dashes and gaps; the two dashed curves are traced lines: the middle of the stroke found at every 0.4 pt across the frame and smoothed (the remaining differences 0.15 pt in the mean), given as 240 points each, with the middle lengths of their dashes and gaps; the bars of the scale stand at their measured angles and widths (180 bars; 4 of them lie under other ink and are set between their neighbours); the lines of ten degrees and the ticks of five at their measured angles. The 67 letters and words are set at the centres of their printed ink, turned as printed (a word by the turning at which its ink is lowest, a letter of the scale by its place on the ring), the words narrowed or spread to their printed lengths; they are written by hand in the print and stand here in type
